title: MooDeng Arbitrageurs
tagline: An automated arbitrage bot that operates across multiple EVM-compatible chains, with a user-friendly interface for setup, monitoring, and profit distribution.
description:
- Automatically route funds to a DEX-DEX arbitrage bot and let user choose their own solution (Chain, DEXes, Pairs) and the bot will collect the market data and check the arbitrage opportunities (which can be exported as csv).
- Whenever the bot made some profit (+PnL%). It will send the logs to telegram group and also record data to the database.
how_its_made:
## How It's Made
- Bot will watch the prices from DEXes (Uniswap, Sushiswap). When it's confirmed that there is a room to arbitrage. Then buy at cheapest DEX and suddenly sell at 1inch which usually be the best rate exchange.
- Backend use Python, NodeJS, 1inch SDK
- Frontend use React, NextJS, Tailwind.
